dictionary.Weapon: Derived from the template name, which is authoritative. See Label Mismatch.
dictionary.In-Game Label (from files): gun__locName as written in the files. Copy-pasted and wrong on 15 weapons.
dictionary.Label Mismatch: Yes when the file's label does not match the template it belongs to.
dictionary.Category: From item__weapType, mapped to plain English. Raw value kept in Raw weapType.
dictionary.Chambering: Derived from the first cartridge in the weapon's default ammo belt.
dictionary.Rate of Fire (rpm): gun__shotFreq x 60. shotFreq is shots per second.
dictionary.Magazine Capacity: Largest ammo_holder__ammoCount among compatible magazines. Smaller options are on Weapon x Magazine.
dictionary.Weapon Weight (kg): item__weight - the weapon empty, without a magazine.
dictionary.Inertial Mass (kg): gun__inertialMass - drives how sluggishly the weapon swings, not carried weight.
dictionary.Reload - Empty (s): gun__reloadTime - reload from a fully empty weapon.
dictionary.Reload - Tactical (s): gun__altReloadTime - reload with a round still chambered.
dictionary.Max Spread (deg): gun_spread__maxDeltaAngle - the fixed accuracy cone. Lower is tighter.
dictionary.Max Deviation: gun_deviation__maxDeviation - ceiling on the extra dispersion from movement and sustained fire.
dictionary.Deviation Settle Tau (s): gun_deviation__shotTau - how quickly deviation decays once you stop firing.
dictionary.Recoil Rise Mult: gun__recoilRiseMult - how much of the recoil goes vertical.
dictionary.Recoil Direction: gun__recoilDir - horizontal bias of the recoil pattern.
dictionary.Barrel Length (m): gun__length - used for muzzle position and wall clipping, not ballistics.
dictionary.Keeps Round In Chamber: gun__saveAmmoInChamberOnReload - true means a tactical reload keeps +1.
dictionary.Ammo Belts: Named ammo sets the weapon can be issued, e.g. default, ap, tracer.
dictionary.Scope Options: Number of attachments offered in that slot. Their effects are NOT merged in.
dictionary.Total Attachment Options: Sum across all mod slots. A rough proxy for how customisable the weapon is.
dictionary.In-Game Blurb: item__locDetails, the short description shown in game. Occasionally disagrees with the computed rate of fire.
dictionary.Loaded Weight (kg): DERIVED formula: weapon weight plus magazine capacity at a flat 12 g per round. Rough.
dictionary.Seconds to Empty Magazine: DERIVED formula: capacity divided by rounds per second.
dictionary.Sustained RoF incl. Reload (rpm): DERIVED formula: rounds divided by (time to empty plus empty reload). The rate you actually sustain.
dictionary.Core Diameter (mm): damageCaliber - the penetrating core, smaller than the case calibre.
dictionary.Effective Distance (m): effectiveDistance - the range the game treats as the round's useful envelope.
dictionary.Incendiary Multiplier: onHitChanceMultFire - relative chance of starting a fire on hit.
dictionary.Relative Pen Index: Raw DeMarre output. NOT millimetres. Compare cartridges to each other only.
dictionary.Pen Coefficient Source: Whether the DeMarre coefficients came from the cartridge file or its projectile type.

readme: Unlike aircraft and tank weapons, the .blk files under human_weapons/ hold almost nothing - just animation hooks. The real stats live in an entity-component template system under templates/inf/, where each template inherits from others through a '_use' list.
Flattens that inheritance: parents merged first, child values override. 2,894 templates resolved; 81 of them declare item__weapType and are treated as weapons.
A value can be inherited rather than declared. Where that matters the sheet says so - see Label Mismatch below.
LABEL MISMATCH — A BUG IN GAIJIN'S FILES, NOT THIS SHEET
gun__locName is copy-pasted in several templates. m249_para literally carries the label 'AK-74M'. rpg_2 says 'RPG-7'. pp_2000 says 'PP 19 Vityaz'. rp_46 says 'DP-M'. 15 of 81 weapons are affected.

The template name is treated as authoritative and drives the Weapon column. The file's own label is kept in 'In-Game Label (from files)' and the mismatch is flagged per row. Do not trust the label column.

Raw DeMarre output from the coefficients in each cartridge file - 84 of 97 cartridges carry them. It is NOT millimetres. The scale factor that converts it to mm is not in the files and has not been fitted for small arms.
Compare cartridges against each other, especially within the same chambering. Do not present it as a penetration value and do not compare it to the tank workbook's numbers.
have no coefficients at all. Blank, not guessed.
There is no battle rating here. Infantry weapons are not economy units, so wpcost has nothing for them.
Attachment counts are how many options exist per slot, not their effects. Scope, muzzle and grip stat changes live in separate mod templates and are not merged in.
Damage per hit is not a single number in this engine. It comes out of the damage model from bullet mass, velocity and calibre against the target's armour parts.
Spread and deviation are two different systems. Max Spread is the cone; the deviation fields model how the cone grows with movement and sustained fire.
13 entries are not really weapons - drones, supply boxes, detonators, a tactical phone. Kept because the game files classify them the same way. They have no rate of fire.
